notes.title: Heroes Wanted 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is the Heroes Wanted developer.

Version 1.1 has been updated.

Changes

The Demon Lord's attack patterns have been changed, and new attacks have been added.
Frost Giant and Efreet monsters have been added.
The Golden Goblin sometimes appears in the ? event.
You can now use up to 3 user profiles.
The difficulty composition has been slightly changed. Along with that, the total difficulty has increased from 12 levels to 15 levels.
In the summoning event, you can now choose 1 out of 2 legendary cards.
New artifacts, cards, and equipment have been added.
The performance of the Coins and Sleek Feather among the starting artifacts has been changed.
Fixed a bug where continuing the game would fail if the checkbox in the reward confirmation popup was checked.
Fixed a bug where reward cards were changing.
Fixed a bug where you could rest multiple times with certain artifacts.

Thank you for waiting.

notes.title: Heroes Wanted 1.1.0 Beta Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is the Heroes Wanted developer.

We have updated version 1.1 to the beta branch.

Changes

2 new attack patterns have been added to the Demon Lord.
Frost Giant and Efreet monsters have been added.
The Golden Goblin sometimes appears in the ? event.
You can now use up to 3 user profiles.
The difficulty composition has been slightly changed. Along with that, the total difficulty has increased from 12 levels to 15 levels.
In the summoning event, you can now choose 1 out of 2 legendary cards.
New artifacts, cards, and equipment have been added.

The method to access the beta version is the same as before.

Library -> Right-click Heroes Wanted -> Properties -> Betas -> Private Beta Beta key: betabetabeta

Thank you for waiting.

Note: The beta version and official version load/save the same user save data.
However, ongoing battle data is not compatible between versions.

notes.title: Heroes Wanted 1.0.0 Official Version Released
notes.notes:
Hello from the developer of Heroes Wanted.


Thank you for waiting. We are pleased to present the official version to you today.
Thanks to your invaluable feedback and support while enjoying the game, we were able to passionately develop it throughout the considerable time from Early Access to the official release.

We are truly grateful to everyone who participated in the development process.
We will continue to improve the game even after the official version release.

Thank you.



------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch Notes
New characters have been added.
12 types of cards have been added.
41 types of artifacts have been added.
2 types of consumables have been added.
2 types of equipment have been added.
Difficulty settings have been refined into 12 levels.
3 rarely used starting artifacts have been changed.
5 new starting artifacts have been added.
The starting deck setting system has been removed.
The limit on the number of actions that can be taken at the inn has been removed.
New type of ? events have been added.
Map compositions have been changed.
Japanese, Spanish, Russian and German translations have been added.
A new feature has been added to view your play history.

Hello from the Heroes Wanted devs.

After the last major update, we received many feedback from our community.
That feedback has been taken well under our consideration and has laid the foundation for this major update.
Players will be able to experience new various content and system improvements through today's 0.9.33 version update.

notes.title: Heroes Wanted 0.9.20 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hello from the Heroes Wanted Team!


Many players have left various opinions and feedback regarding the development of the game.
First of all, we would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has shown a great deal of interest and support for Heroes Wanted.

In today's update, we have addressed the difficulty levels that have been mentioned by our players. 
The overall difficulty of the game has been adjusted. 

We understand that the difficulty level of World 2 is too high, and that it may lead to a game-over even before players get to build their preferred decks. 
Based on this understanding, we have decreased the stats of the World 2 monsters. 
We have also decreased the number of monsters in the Boss battle. 
Furthermore, we have slightly increased the difficulty levels of World 3 and 4 to enhance the gameplay experience in the later stages of the game. 

We hope that these adjustments allow our players to even further enjoy creating decks and strategizing. 

We will continue to stay attentive to the voices of our players to improve Heroes Wanted. 
Thank you for all the support and feedback!

Thank you.

notes.title: Heroes Wanted Ver. 0.9.18 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hello from the Heroes Wanted Team!

Many players have provided feedback after the recent major update, particularly regarding the Retreat mechanism and difficulty balances!
Today, we are pleased to announce a patch addressing some of these elements. 
For a detailed review, please refer to the path notes below. 

Thank you!
--------------------------------------------
Fixes

 Reduced the difficulty gap between the early and late stages of each world.
 The same cards cannot retreat multiple times in one turn now.
 Blocking can now block Poison damage. 
 Modified the application method of Paralysis.
 Blocking all damage with Block can now prevent Paralysis, even without a Shield. 
 Mdified the Chinese localization for Triple Potion and Straight Potion. 
 Further clarified the skill description of the Saint of Raidance card.
 Fixed a bug where the Attack Count increase effect would not disappear when activated by a Chain Attack.

notes.title: Heroes Wanted Patch Note 12/20
notes.notes:
Hello from the Heroes Wanted devs.

A lot of consideration was gone into this update, thanks to all the valuable feedback and opinion from our players.

As we gathered incremental improvements, the game underwent more changes than initially expected.

In this update, we prioritized on providing players with more flexibility in building decks. We've introduced new features and adjusted existing systems to allow players more freedom.

While there are still some challenging aspects, playing with your desired deck should now be easier than before.
We highly value your feedback on this update, and will continue to eagerly take them into account for further improvements. 
That said — starting this update, we look forward to receiving your opinions directly.
It would mean a lot to us if you could fill out the survey form below!
(Survey Link)

Despite the game being a work in process, we are grateful that players are enjoying it.

We'll see you again with the next update. Toodles!

----------------------------------------------

Major Changes

Map

 Added World 4 (Burning Village).
 Added two events (Weapon Shop, Life Spring).
 Added two new monsters and two new bosses.
 Players can now reroll cards at the Tavern.
 Difficulty options (Easy, Normal, and Hard) are available.


Card

 Adjusted the balance between cards.
 Increased the probability of higher-tier cards appearing.
 Added new card skills. 


Equipment

 Adjusted the balance of equipment.
 Added 6 new equipment.


Game System

 Removed the 'Food' resource. 
 Adjusted the player's HP and mana values. 
 Players can now remove cards at the camp.
 Decreased the number of cards needed to merge to 2. 
 Merging can now enhance cards up to level 2. 


Accessibility

 Added a card sorting feature.
 Added a fast mode. 


Bug Fixes and Optimization

 Fixed a bug that was triggered upon pressing the map button during scene transitions
 Fixed a bug that incorrectly displayed the ratio of card combinations.

notes.title: Ver.0.9.13 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello from the Heroes Wanted Team!

First of all, we'd like to thank everyone for all your feedback and support during the post-launch period.

With today's patch version 0.9.13, we're addressing two of the most popular feedback points: a lack of explanation in the Guide, and some nerfing and balancing to the difficulty of the later chapters!

Check out the full patch notes below for more details.

We're grateful for your continued support of our game Heroes Wanted, and we hope you'll stay tuned for more updates to make your gaming experience more enjoyable.

Thank you!
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BALANCE

 Reduced the HP and damage of the Giant Scorpion.
 Reduced difficulty for early stage of Chapter 3.
 Made some minor adjustments to the placement of normal monsters in the Frog Tribe Forest.


Accessibility

 Added an effect to make it easier to recognize cards that can retreat in combat.
 Guidebook: Added descriptions of leader settings and leader skills.
 Guidebook: Added a Miscellaneous & Tips section to compile more helpful information.
 Clarified that combining cards does not combine base cards.
 Displayed unclaimed rewards at the top of the Leave button.


Bugs

 Fixed an inaccuracy in the English description of Combine Cards.
 Fixed the Chinese skill description for Dark Mage+ not displaying.
 Fixed some Chinese localization not displaying correctly.
 Fixed a bug which happens when paralyzed cards go to the graveyard.
 Fixed a bug where the game launch icon would not display normally on Mac.

notes.title: Heroes Wanted Ver.0.9.12 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello from the Heroes Wanted Team!

We would like to express our gratitude for the various feedback and reports from our players.
We have addressed and applied hotfixes for issues that could be quickly resolved.

In particular, we have fixed a bug where a new game wouldn't start after the end of a game.
This issue has been resolved, allowing players a smooth replay experience. 

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. 
Should you encounter any further issues or have any questions, please do not hesitate to share them with us. 

Thank you, 
the Heroes Wanted Team.
